title: PAYLOAD ransomware attacks through Active Directory GPO
content: In April 2026, a manufacturing organization in the Middle East suffered a ransomware attack where threat actors with domain admin privileges weaponized Active Directory Group Policy Objects to achieve domain-wide impact without deploying ransomware binaries on Windows endpoints. title: Don't Call Us, We'll Call Your APIs | TraderTraitor Backdoors Resurface on Victim With No Crypto Ties
content: In 2026, the DPRK-sponsored Lazarus subgroup TraderTraitor continued campaigns targeting cryptocurrency entities, including a high-profile attack on LayerZero resulting in $292 million theft from KelpDAO. title: Threat Brief: Active Exploitation of PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257
content: Active exploitation of PAN-OS vulnerability CVE-2026-0257 has been observed, targeting GlobalProtect portal and gateway components. The authentication bypass flaw allows unauthorized attackers to circumvent security controls and establish VPN connections. Targeted industries: Education, Finance, Healthcare. Associated malware: Qilin, Brave Prince - S0252, Settra.

title: Ukraine's State Data-Exchange System Targeted by Russian-Speaking Operator via Graylog Log4Shell
content: Between May and September 2026, a Russian-speaking operator systematically targeted Ukraine's state data-exchange infrastructure by exploiting Log4Shell vulnerabilities in Graylog servers.
